name: Isolated HV bus voltage sensing with resistor ladder and isolated amplifier
function: Divides an 800 V DC bus to the 2 V input of an isolated amplifier and converts the differential isolated output to a 0-3.3 V single-ended ADC signal.
operating_conditions: Full scale 800 V -> 1.574 V at the amplifier input (78.7 % of 2 V).

required_components.source_refdes: not resolved from text extraction (10.0 kOhm per §3.2.1)

required_components.value_or_part: OPA2320AIDRGT with 10.0 k / 8.06 k 0.1 % resistor network and 330 pF capacitors (Figure 3-2)

design_calculations.name: Per-resistor stress
design_calculations.expression: V_R = V_bus * R_top / (n * R_top + R_bottom); P = V_R^2 / R_top

interface_requirements: High-side GND of the amplifier is the bus negative; supply from an isolated source on that node.
pcb_constraints: Distribute the ladder along a creepage path; keep HV ladder away from low-voltage traces.
Filter capacitor at the amplifier input; differential output routed as a pair to the conversion stage.
validation_notes: Scaling and resistor stress recomputed (EC-015, EC-021). Resistor voltage rating vs. 100 V per element was not checked against the resistor datasheet.
limitations: Accuracy depends on resistor tolerance, voltage coefficient and amplifier input impedance - not analysed.

alternatives.trade_off: More noise-robust over long traces; needs an MCU sigma-delta filter.
